data.body: PHASE 3 — REB epic closeouts (7/7 resolved): fruitfly, ibex, goitered, wrasse closed; scaup + wolf closed WITH live-infra verification per operator ruling (EBS scratch mounted + workloads moved, nene r7g.large resize applied via 2889, ladybug Docker memory limits + gate admission control live, max_concurrent_gates=2, buildkit 5GiB cap, memory alarms exercised, 0 AWS alarms); peacock downgraded epic->idea per ruling (2 children failed landed-verification).
